description: Fixed cross-implementation test vectors for the manifest-v1 build-digest canonicalisation, shared byte-for-byte by shipledger (producer) and shipledger-release-control (independent consumer). Each vector's `entries` are [packageRelativePosixPath, sha256HexOfFileContent] pairs that have ALREADY been content-hashed, isolating the canonicalisation contract. A conforming implementation MUST: (1) order entries by the UTF-8 byte sequence of the path (== Unicode code-point order, NOT UTF-16 code-unit order); (2) serialise the ordered array of [path, hash] pairs with RFC 8785 (JCS) — for this all-string data identical to compact JSON; (3) return `sha256:` + lowercaseHex(sha256(utf8Bytes(serialisation))). The `canonical` field is the exact serialised string that is hashed. NOTE: the empty-set vector documents the canonical form only; the production computeBuildDigest fails closed on an empty/incomplete build rather than emitting this digest.

vectors.name: non-ascii-ordering
vectors.note: Locks UTF-8-byte path ordering: BMP U+FFFD sorts BEFORE astral U+10000 by UTF-8 bytes, whereas a naive JavaScript string `<` (UTF-16 code units) would sort them the other way. A consumer that sorts by code unit computes a different digest and MUST fail this vector.
